Use Graphify 0.9.25 only as a project scoped bounded optional local code map provider with source verification no installer hook instruction memory global graph or semantic backend ownership and Baron Survey fallback.

Distill only non overlapping Hallmark and Matt Pocock techniques into existing Baron owned frontend interface architecture and Product Harness assets. Do not duplicate Superpowers workflow frontend ownership or quality gates.
